cells.gaps: No delivery plan is stated for this instrument in the rows (its Plano Operacional is approved with it but no row gives actions or cost), and no published report against its targets has been found; one older INTIC report (MOZ-031) gives its period as 2019-2023 against 2019-2028 in the resolution. The National Digital Transformation Strategy 2027-2036, launched for drafting on 12 Feb 2026, went through validation in May 2026 and awaits Council of Ministers approval (MOZ-087, MOZ-089); it would replace this plan.
cells.note: Plano Estratégico para a Sociedade de Informação 2019-2028 (Resolution 52/2019): approved, text gazetted, period runs to 2028, so stage 3. Stage 4 needs a delivery plan and published results, and none is held.
